breakdown.description: The stem constraints are rotated from the stated tangential condition u_y = 0 on vertical stems to a normal condition u_x = 0
breakdown.reason: The generated specification applies u_x = 0 on the vertical stem faces at x=0.3 and x=0.5, which matches the incorrect incomplete prompt rather than the ground truth. The ground truth specifies u_y = 0 on these vertical stems (tangential constraint). The agent failed to correct this error and instead repeated the wrong normal displacement constraint (u_x = 0) from the flawed prompt.
